title: Survivors ready… GO! 🏝️ Thanks so much to the Paley Museum for inviti...
transcript: Come with me to check out the brand new survivor 50 exhibit at the Paley Museum in New York City! This exhibit features information and artifacts from across the show's 25 year history. This includes tribal immunity idols, immunity necklaces, tribe flags, and of course a recreation of Jeff's iconic look. And if you look really carefully, you might even find a hidden Immunity Idol on the floor! There are also a ton of great photo ops throughout the experience, including a mini tribal experience and where you could take a photo by the tribal fire and cast your vote for who you'd like to vote off the island. Now this exhibit is not super large, you could probably see everything in about 10 to 30 minutes. But despite its small footprint, it really is filled to the brim with so much survivor lore and fun facts. Alongside so many cool props from the show, including this tribe flag from David versus Goliath and this un aired guess your weight challenge from the first season survivor Borneo. So if you are a survivor fan in New York, I definitely recommend checking it out. It is right in the heart of Midtown and admission is $20 for adults, which includes access to the rest of the museum as well.
classificationReason: Non-theater content — describes visiting a Survivor TV show exhibit at the Paley Museum in NYC. Not related to any stage production on the list.
